name: WASA-at-COSY
full_name: Wide Angle Shower Apparatus at COSY
summary: WASA-at-COSY operated at COSY, Forschungszentrum Jülich. WASA had previously operated in Sweden, but the dark-photon sample in this record comes from its German COSY deployment, not Uppsala.
detection_principle: π⁰ mesons produced in pp reactions are reconstructed in π⁰→γe⁺e⁻, with dark-photon decay peaks sought in the electron-pair mass spectrum.

status.label: This record covers the completed dark-photon search published in 2013

results.summary: No dark photons; a 90% confidence upper limit on ε² at approximately 5×10⁻⁶ was obtained. See the paper for the mass dependence.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
